request.description:
This HTTP POST request is used to check if a user is registered. The request should be sent to /buyer/is_user_regsitered with a form-data request body type.

The response will have a status code of 200, along with a JSON body containing information about the user's registration status and details.

The "data" field in the response includes various user details, while "is_registered" indicates the user's registration status. The user has requested to "Add documentation" for this request.

### Buyer Register OTP

This endpoint is used to register a buyer with OTP.

#### Request Body

- `first_name` (text): The first name of the buyer.
- `last_name` (text): The last name of the buyer.
- `dob` (text): The date of birth of the buyer.
- `app_user_type` (text): The type of the application user.
    

#### Response

- `success`: Indicates the success status of the request.
- `error`: Indicates any error occurred during the request.
- `status`: Indicates the status of the request.
- `data`: Indicates the data returned from the request.
- `message`: Additional message related to the request.
- `opt_number`: The OTP number for the user.
- `user_id`: The unique identifier of the user.
- `active_step`: Indicates the active step in the registration process.
    

The response will have a status code of 200 for a successful request.

This API endpoint allows the buyer to trade a product. The request should be sent as an HTTP POST to the specified URL. The request should include the following form-data parameters:

- start (text): Represents the start of the trade.
- prod_cat_id (text): Represents the product category ID.
- buyer_id (text): Represents the buyer's ID.
    

The response to the request will have a status code of 200. The response body will include a "success" flag indicating the success status, along with a "data" array containing trade product details. Each trade product object in the "data" array includes various attributes such as product ID, title, logo, details, quantity, price, trade status, and more. Additionally, there are arrays for trade product bidding and rating details.

Please note that the response also includes paths for images, invoice, and profile, along with other miscellaneous fields.

### Manage Product for Buyer

This endpoint allows the buyer to manage their products. The HTTP POST request should be sent to `{{api_base_url}}/buyer/manage_product`.

#### Form-Data Parameters

- `start` (text): Description not provided.
- `prod_cat_id` (text): Description not provided.
- `buyer_id` (text): Description not provided.
    

#### Response

The API returns a status code of 200. The response body contains an object with the following keys:

- `success` (number): Indicates the success status of the request.
- `data` (array): Contains detailed information about the managed products, including various attributes such as product details, pricing, logistics, and trade status.
- `message` (string): Additional message, if any.
- `total` (number): Total count of items in the response.
- `image_path` (string): Path for product images.
- `seller_invoice_path` (string): Path for seller invoices.
- `client_profile_path` (string): Path for client profiles.
- `prod_master_image_path` (string): Path for product master images.
    

For each item in the `data` array, there are multiple attributes providing details about the managed product, trade status, bidding information, and buyer interest.

### Add New Product for Buyer

This endpoint allows the buyer to show newly added products as per category.

#### Request Body

- `prod_cat_id` (text) - The ID of the product category.
    

#### Response

- Status: 200
- `success` (number) - Indicates the success status of the operation.
- `data` (array) - Contains information about the newly added product, including ID, details, title, logo, quantity, unit, price, images, status, and thumbnail.
- `message` (string) - Additional information or error message.

This endpoint allows the client to retrieve trending products for buyers. The HTTP POST request should be sent to {{api_base_url}}/buyer/trending_product.

### Request Body

The request should include the following form-data parameters:

- `prod_cat_id` (text): The ID of the product category.
    

### Response

Upon a successful execution (Status: 200), the response will contain:

- `success` (integer): Indicates the success status of the request.
- `data` (array): Contains information about trending products, including their IDs, images, bid count, title, logo, and thumbnail.
- `message` (string): An optional message from the server.

### Add Documentation

This endpoint makes an HTTP POST request to {{api_base_url}}/buyer/trade_product_bidding to submit a bid for a specific product. The request should include the following form-data parameters:

- `product_id`: (text) The ID of the product for which the bid is being submitted.
- `buyer_id`: (text) The ID of the buyer submitting the bid.
- `qty`: (text) The quantity of the product being bid for.
- `qty_unit`: (text) The unit of quantity for the product.
- `bid_price`: (text) The price offered for the bid.

The response to this request will have a status code of 200 and will include the following fields:

- `success`: A flag indicating the success of the bid submission.
- `data`: An array containing any relevant data related to the bid submission.
- `message`: A message indicating the outcome of the bid submission.

## Buyer Action

This endpoint is used to perform a buyer action. The HTTP POST request should be made to ../buyer/buyer_action.

### Request Body

- form-data
    
    - id (text): The ID of the action.
    - status (text): The status of the action.
    - product_id (text): The ID of the product.
    - seller_id (text): The ID of the seller.
    - buyer_id (text): The ID of the buyer.

This endpoint allows the buyer to add interest in a specific product. The HTTP POST request should be made to {{api_base_url}}/buyer/add_interest_onproduct.

### Request Body
The request should include the following form-data parameters:

### Response

- `data` (boolean): Indicates whether the interest addition was successful.
- `message` (string): A message related to the response, if any.

This endpoint allows the addition of a trade product rating for a buyer. The HTTP POST request should be sent to {{api_base_url}}/buyer/add_trade_product_rating.

### Request Body
The request should have a form-data body type with the following parameters:
- `buyer_id` (text): The ID of the buyer.
- `rating_id` (text): The ID of the rating.
- `seller_id` (text): The ID of the seller.

### Response
Upon a successful execution, the API returns a status code of 200 and a JSON response with the following structure:
```

    "status": 0,
    "data": true,
    "message": ""
}
```
- `status`: Indicates the status of the operation.
- `data`: A boolean value indicating the success of the operation.
- `message`: Additional information or error message, if applicable.

The response returns a status code of 200 along with the rating details for the buyer. The "data" object includes the buyer's ID, along with counts for happy, average, and poor ratings.

## Buyer Statistics

This endpoint allows you to retrieve the statistics for a specific buyer. 

### Request Parameters
- `buyer_id` (text) - The ID of the buyer for whom the statistics are being retrieved.
- `prod_cat_id` (text) - The ID of the product category for which the statistics are being retrieved.
- `year` (text) - The year for which the statistics are being retrieved.
- `month` (text) - The month for which the statistics are being retrieved.
- `day` (text) - The day for which the statistics are being retrieved.

### Response
Upon a successful request, the response will have a status code of 200 and will include the following:
- `success` - Indicates the success status of the request.
- `data` - An array containing the statistical data for the specified buyer, product category, year, month, and day.
  - `status` - The status of the statistical data.
  - `row_count` - The count of rows in the statistical data.
  - `prod_cat_id` - The ID of the product category.
  - `status_title` - The title associated with the status.
  - `status_class` - The class associated with the status.
- `message` - An optional message related to the request.
